notes:
- New: press Ctrl+F to find text on the current page.
- New: an optional "Remember department code and username" tick on the sign-in screen so you don't have to retype them — your password is never saved.
- The browser now holds the full screen more reliably after a screen lock or user switch, so it can't be moved aside during a session.
- Updates that were already downloaded are no longer downloaded again, and apply automatically the next time the browser is opened.
